breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes the thin-walled closed-tube (Bredt) shear-flow approach, framing it as a 'parallel check' alongside the exact torsion formula. The ground truth prompt exclusively uses the exact thick-walled torsion relation (J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32) with no mention of the thin-walled approximation. By retaining and elaborating on the thin-walled model (computing r_m, A_m, q, and τ_thin), the agent failed to fully remove the inconsistency — it merely repositioned the erroneous approach rather than eliminating it.
